intent: migrate the reporting jobs to the new queue

gates.title: No focus markers narrow the suite
No tests were disabled to reach green

finding.message: This change adds 2 test-suppression marker(s), budget is 0 (tests/test_jobs.py:4 (skip), tests/test_jobs.py:19 (xfail)). Disabling a test converts a red suite into a green one without fixing anything, and nobody re-reads a green suite.
finding.fix: Fix or delete the underlying test instead of skipping it. If a skip is genuinely correct, raise the budget deliberately with --max-new-suppression N and say why in the PR body.

finding.message: The suite exited 0 but reported zero passing tests. An empty run is not evidence of anything — this is what a mis-scoped selector or a collection error looks like.
finding.fix: Check the test command's path/pattern arguments actually select tests.
